_about: How a tournament is set up for the week. green_decel multiplies how quickly a ball stops on the green (below 1 is a faster green). rough_power multiplies how much of a full swing the rough allows (below 1 is thicker). pin_tuck is how far, in metres, each pin is moved off the centre line, staying on the green. gate multiplies ticket income.

setups.name: Friendly
setups.blurb: Slower greens, lighter rough, pins left alone. A smaller gate.

setups.name: Standard
setups.blurb: The course as the members play it.

setups.name: Stern
setups.blurb: Faster greens, thicker rough, pins tucked off the centre. The gate pays more.
